name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in olive oil.
Add garlic and spices, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until set.

name: Red lentil soup
steps: Add lentils, cumin and stock. Simmer 20 minutes.
Blend, then finish with lemon juice.

name: Pasta al pomodoro
steps: Blister tomatoes with garlic in olive oil.
Toss with pasta, basil and parmesan.

name: Chicken tacos
steps: Slice and squeeze lime over it.
Fill warm tortillas with chicken, avocado, onion and coriander.
